cases.question: Ninawezaje kupakua data yangu kama faili ya Excel?
cases.answer:
Kufungua mradi wako, nenda kwenye DATA > Downloads, chagua aina ya usafishaji “XLSX (Excel)”, kisha bonyeza EXPORT na baada ya usafishaji kukamilika bonyeza DOWNLOAD ili upakue faili ya Excel.  
http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/export_download.html

cases.question: كيف أضيف سؤالاً لتسجيل موقع GPS في النموذج؟
cases.answer:
لإضافة سؤال لتسجيل موقع GPS في النموذج استخدم Formbuilder ثم :

1. اضغط زر **+ ADD QUESTION**.  
2. اختر نوع السؤال **GPS Point** (أو Line/Area إذا تريد خطاً أو مساحة).  
3. أدخل نص سؤالك في حقل **Label** واحفظ.

المصدر: http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/gps_questions.html#adding-a-gps-question-in-the-formbuilder

cases.question: Como faço para que uma pergunta seja obrigatória no formulário?
cases.answer: Marque a opção **“Resposta obrigatória”** como **Sim** ao editar a pergunta no Formbuilder, ou adicione `required` = `yes/true` na planilha XLSForm para torná‑la obrigatória. http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/es/question_options.html#respuesta-obligatoria http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/es/question_options_xls.html#preguntas-obligatorias

cases.question: मैं कैसे करूँ कि कोई सवाल तभी दिखे जब पिछले सवाल का जवाब "हाँ" हो?
cases.answer:
किसी प्रश्न को केवल तब दिखाने के लिए जब पिछले प्रश्न का उत्तर “हाँ” हो, फ़ॉर्म‑बिल्डर या XLSForm में **skip logic** (relevance condition) का उपयोग करें। उस प्रश्न की `relevant` शर्त में पिछले प्रश्न के उत्तर को `${question_name} = 'yes'` या `${question_name} = 'हाँ'` के रूप में लिखें; तभी वह प्रश्न दिखाई देगा। (उदाहरण के लिए `relevant = ${prev_q} = 'yes'`.)  

स्रोत: http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/form_logic.html, http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/skip_logic_xls.html

cases.question: ¿Cómo activo la verificación en dos pasos en mi cuenta?
cases.answer:
1. Haz clic en el ícono de tu perfil (esquina superior derecha).  
2. Selecciona **CONFIGURACIÓN DE LA CUENTA**.  
3. En la ventana **Seguridad**, localiza la sección **Autenticación de dos factores** y desactiva el botón **Activado**.  
4. Introduce el código de 6 dígitos generado por la aplicación de autenticación en tu smartphone y pulsa **Siguiente**.  

URL: http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/es/two_factor_authentication.html#deshabilitar-la-2fa

cases.question: pulldata
cases.answer: pulldata() retrieves values from an attached CSV file during form entry. Set up a CSV with a unique index column, upload it to the project, then use a calculate field like pulldata('file', 'col', 'index', 'key') to pull the matching value. Useful for auto‑filling related data and reducing re‑entry. http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/pull_data_kobotoolbox.html http://kobo.local/docs/xlsform/index.html#how-to-pull-data-from-csv

cases.question: how does select_one_from_file work with a csv?
cases.answer:
Select One from File lets a respondent pick one option from a CSV uploaded to the project. In the XLSForm you set the type to `select_one_from_file <filename>.csv`. The CSV must have a **name** column (the stored value) and a **label** column (what the user sees). If your columns have different names, add a **parameters** column with `value=<colname> label=<colname>` to map them. After uploading the CSV to Kobo, the question appears in the Formbuilder and shows the CSV’s labels as choices.  

Sources: http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/select_from_file_xls.html#setting-up-your-xlsform, http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/external_file.html#setting-up-the-question-in-the-formbuilder, http://kobo.local/docs/xlsform/index.html#multiple-choice-from-file

cases.question: enumerators keep getting "Value not allowed" on the age question
cases.answer:
Add a constraint (e.g., `. >= 0 and . <= 150`) and a custom `constraint_message` for the age field so enumerators see a helpful error instead of the default “Value not allowed”. See the constraint and error‑message sections.  

http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/constraints_xls.html#customizing-constraint-error-messages  
http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/validation_criteria.html#error-message

cases.question: the web form says my submissions are still pending and won't send
cases.answer: Submissions stay “pending” when the web form is offline or the device hasn’t re‑connected. Open the form while online so it fully caches, then check the queue counter and ensure the device regains internet – queued submissions upload automatically. If the form requires sign‑in, log out below the Submit button, close the form, reopen it and sign in with an authorized account. Also avoid clearing the browser cache while collecting, as that deletes stored drafts and queued submissions. http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/data_through_webforms.html#troubleshooting http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/data_through_webforms.html#data-collection-modes

cases.question: can each enumerator only see the submissions they made themselves?
cases.answer: Data Collectors may see the list of all Forms in the Project, and retrieve basic information about them, but may only create new Submissions. They cannot see any Submissions. http://kobo.local/docs/odk/central-users.html#web-user-roles

cases.question: Comment chiffrer les données de mon formulaire pour que personne d'autre ne puisse les lire ?
cases.answer:
Ajoutez une clé publique RSA dans la colonne `public_key` de l’onglet `settings` de votre XLSForm, puis déployez le formulaire ; les soumissions seront chiffrées sur le téléphone et ne pourront être déchiffrées qu’avec la clé privée correspondante via ODK Briefcase.  
http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/fr/encrypting_forms.html  
http://kobo.local/docs/xlsform/index.html#encrypted-forms

cases.question: how do I put an offline basemap (mbtiles) on the phone for the geopoint question?
cases.answer:
Prepare the .mbtiles file, copy it to the device (e.g., via Drive, email, USB), then in ODK Collect → Settings → Maps add it as a reference_layer or import it to /sdcard/Android/data/org.odk.collect.android/files/projects/<project>/layers. Select the layer in a geopoint/geotrace/geoshape question.  

Sources: http://kobo.local/docs/odk/collect-offline-maps.html#quick-start  
http://kobo.local/docs/odk/collect-offline-maps.html#manually-importing-mbtiles-files

cases.question: regex constraint to check a phone number has exactly 10 digits
can I record how long enumerators spend on each question?
cases.answer:
Yes. Add an **audit** question (type `audit`, name `audit`) to the form; KoboCollect will then log when each screen is opened and how long enumerators spend on each question. The logs are saved as CSV media attachments with each submission.  

http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/form_meta.html#audit-metadata-question  
http://kobo.local/docs/odk/form-audit-log.html

cases.question: configure many phones with the same Collect settings using a QR code
cases.answer:
1. Open the project on a device already configured. Settings → Project Management → Reconfigure with QR Code → Choose QR Code and screenshot it.  
2. On each other phone open KoboCollect → Configure with QR Code and scan (or import) the saved QR image. The app loads the same server URL, username, password and project settings.  

Source: http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/kobocollect_on_android_latest.html#setting-up-kobocollect-with-a-qr-code, http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/kobocollect_settings.html#project-management

cases.question: repeat_count from the number of household members
cases.answer:
Add a column `repeat_count` to the `hh_member` repeat and set its value to `${num_hh_members}` (the integer question that asks for the number of household members). The repeat will then appear exactly that many times.  

Sources: http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/repeat_groups_xls.html#setting-repeat-counts, http://kobo.local/docs/xlsform/index.html#fixed-repeat-counts

cases.question: Collect dice que no puede descargar el formulario, ¿qué reviso?
cases.answer:
Verifica: que el proyecto esté implementado y tenga conexión a Internet; que la URL del servidor en KoboCollect sea correcta (sin errores tipográficos) y que la fecha del dispositivo sea válida. Si la lista de formularios tarda o muestra “Error getting form list”, revisa la URL y la conectividad, y archiva formularios no usados para reducir la carga.  
http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/es/data_collection_kobocollect.html#resolucion-de-problemas  
http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/es/troubleshooting_kobocollect.html

cases.question: what goes in the choice_filter column?
cases.answer: The choice_filter column contains an expression that filters the rows of the choices sheet for that select question. The expression must evaluate to True or False and typically references a column in choices (e.g., category) and a previous answer (e.g., ${job_category}) — e.g., `category=${job_category}` or `selected(${parent_q}, name)`. Sources: http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/choice_filters_xls.html#adding-dynamic-choice-filters, http://kobo.local/docs/odk/form-logic.html#filtering-options-in-select-questions

cases.question: jr:choice-name to show the label of the selected choice
cases.answer: Use `jr:choice-label` instead of `jr:choice-name`.

cases.question: which appearances does select_multiple support, like minimal or likert?
cases.answer:
minimal, compact, label, list‑nolabel, autocomplete, likert, horizontal, columns, horizontal‑compact, columns‑pack, columns‑n, quick, quickcompact, map, quick map  

Sources: http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/appearances_xls.html#select-question-types, http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/select_one_and_select_many.html#advanced-appearances

cases.question: In QGIS, how do I load a CSV export with latitude and longitude columns as points?
cases.answer:
Load the CSV, then use **Add Layer → Add Delimited Text Layer**, select the latitude and longitude columns as X and Y fields, and set the CRS to WGS 84.  

Source: http://kobo.local/docs/kobo/upload_to_gis.html

cases.question: QGIS reproject a layer to UTM
cases.answer:
Right‑click the layer → Export → Save Features As… → choose a format (e.g. GeoPackage) → set **CRS** to the desired UTM zone (e.g. WGS 84 / UTM zone 34S) → OK. Repeat for each layer you need in the same UTM projection.  

Sources: http://kobo.local/docs/qgis-docs-en/en/docs/training_manual/vector_analysis/basic_analysis.html#try-yourself-convert-layers-crs  
http://kobo.local/docs/qgis-docs-en/en/docs/user_manual/processing_algs/qgis/vectorgeneral.html#reproject-layer

cases.question: Dans QGIS, comment joindre une table attributaire à une couche par un champ commun ?
cases.answer:
Ouvrez les propriétés de la couche cible → onglet **Jointures**, cliquez sur **Ajouter une jointure**, choisissez la couche à joindre, puis sélectionnez le champ commun de chaque couche. Validez ; les attributs de la table seront ajoutés à la couche.  
http://kobo.local/docs/qgis-docs-fr/fr/docs/user_manual/working_with_vector/joins_relations.html#joining-features-between-two-layers
